answer: Beacon spot-checks with a compute heartbeat guard the harbor. Each epoch the beacon samples random identities; each must solve a fresh puzzle in 60 seconds or its rewards freeze. A farm of 1,000 fakes needs 1,000 heartbeats an epoch, randomly sampled, so it pays 1,000 machine-hours while an honest agent pays one. A failed check ripples a freeze across identities sharing one heartbeat. A nebula of fakes still pays full compute or loses its berth.
